coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: MB360 (1200 4th St)
record.summary: MB360 (1200 4th St) is a 177-unit residential building, the second of two blocks (alongside 701 China Basin St, mission_bay_mb360.geojson) in a single two-block Mission Bay apartment development originally built by BRE Properties (acquired by Essex Property Trust in 2014), with MVE + Partners as prime architect. DataSF Assessor records and the project architect's own project page both give 2016 as this block's construction-completion year.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8711017), address confirmed via DataSF Assessor parcel data and apartment-listing sources; not a hand trace or plan estimate. Trimmed against the adjacent Mission Bay Kids' Park to remove a 69 sq m overlap.

open_questions: Apartment-listing aggregators give inconsistent construction years for this address (2015 in some search summaries), while DataSF Assessor records and the project architect's own project page both give 2016; not fully reconciled.

Contemporaneous press (SFGate, CBS News San Francisco) reported a 5-alarm fire on March 11, 2014 that destroyed a 172-unit building under construction as part of MB360 -- close to this block's 177-unit count -- but no source found gives the destroyed building's street address explicitly, so the fire is not asserted here as having happened to this specific block.
Precise month of this block's actual completion/first occupancy is not sourced beyond the bare Assessor year.
Developer of record beyond BRE Properties/Essex Property Trust, and any subsequent sale history, not researched in this pass.
